name: SK Hynix
day_summary: SK Hynix gapped up +8.6% to an open of ₩2,281,000 on news of a ₩44.2B HBM4 equipment investment and an extended factory digital twin alliance with NVIDIA Omniverse — then reversed sharply all session to close at the low of the day at ₩2,150,000 (+2.33% net). The ₩2,200,000 recovery trigger — the add-to-full-position signal from prior dossiers — was pierced at the open but abandoned by the close. Longs from yesterday's session are up; everyone who bought above ₩2,200K on the gap is underwater. A bearish reversal (shooting star) candle at key resistance is a technical warning even as the fundamental story deepens.

analysis:
## The gap-up that failed: what it tells us

SK Hynix opened June 12 with three legitimate positive catalysts: a ₩44.2 billion HBM4 equipment order, a factory digital twin alliance with NVIDIA Omniverse, and the ongoing secular story of 60–70% HBM4 allocation for NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform. The market's first reaction was to gap the stock up +8.6% to ₩2,281,000 — above the ₩2,200,000 recovery trigger that prior dossiers identified as the add-to-full-position threshold. The market's final answer: ₩2,150,000 at the close, the low of the day.

The [₩44.2B TC Bonder 4.5 Griffin order](https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/ueberblick/sk-hynix-invests-44-2-billion-won-in-hbm4-chip-stacking-gear-as-nvidia/69510034) is not a small capex announcement — thermocompression bonding is the critical manufacturing step for HBM chip-stacking, and committing this equipment spend with M15X commissioning by September 2026 means management has HBM4 production on a definitive timeline, not a roadmap. The [NVIDIA Omniverse digital twin integration](https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/ueberblick/sk-hynix-s-nvidia-alliance-extends-to-digital-twins-as-hbm4-fab-spend/69500219) — cuLitho, CUDA-X, PhysicsNeMo, Fab Digital Twins — extends the NVIDIA partnership from product supply into process co-development. These are genuine strategic deepenings.

And the market said: 'We know. We priced this at ₩2,100K–₩2,200K. We're not paying ₩2,300K yet.'

This is a healthy, rational market response — not a rejection of the thesis, but a refusal to pay a recovery premium before the recovery triggers (ADR clearance, FOMC, ₩2,200K close) are actually confirmed. It also creates a problem: the people who bought the gap above ₩2,200K are now underwater, and they will sell into the next recovery attempt toward ₩2,200K. Overhead supply is the new technical reality.

## Technical analysis

The trend read: **the recovery base is intact but the ₩2,200K ceiling is confirmed; a shooting star candle demands respect as a distribution signal at resistance.**

**The candle pattern:** Open ₩2,281,000, high ₩2,304,000, close ₩2,150,000 (at the session low). This is a textbook shooting star — a long upper wick with almost no lower wick, closing at or near the session low. In classical technical analysis, a shooting star at resistance after an upward gap is one of the higher-reliability bearish reversal signals. It doesn't mean the stock goes straight down; it means buyers above ₩2,200K are trapped and the supply they represent will pressure the stock on any recovery attempt.

**Volume:** 5.29M shares — above the recent 4.9–5.8M average. The above-average volume on the reversal day is the bearish element: it means the distribution was active and institutional, not just thin-session noise. High volume on a reversal candle at resistance confirms the pattern.

**The ₩2,200K zone is now resistance, not merely a target.** Prior dossiers identified ₩2,200,000 as the recovery trigger (add-to-full-position signal) because it represented the prior swing breakdown level and 200-DMA region. Today's gap above it and reversal back below it creates *confirmed resistance* with fresh overhead supply. The zone went from 'target' to 'ceiling.' The add-to-full-position trigger is now: a *sustained closing basis* above ₩2,200K, not just an intraday or gap-up pierce.

**★ Strongest support: ₩2,000,000–₩2,101,000.** This multi-session base (four days of lows in the ₩1,960K–₩2,048K zone, with June 11 and June 12 closing at ₩2,101K and ₩2,150K respectively) remains the primary defense level. A close below ₩2,000,000 changes the technical structure from 'base-building' to 'failed recovery.' The June 11 V-reversal buyers are still in profit above ₩2,101K; they represent a significant natural support base.

**★ Strongest resistance: ₩2,200,000 (now with fresh overhead supply from today's gap-up buyers).** The prior 200-DMA region + recovery trigger + today's gap-up reversal all concentrate at this level. It needs to be cleared on a closing basis, on above-average volume, for the recovery narrative to be confirmed. Until then, it is the ceiling.

**Decision points:** A daily close above ₩2,200K on above-average volume (≥6M shares) = add to full position, target ₩2,407K ATH re-test. A daily close below ₩2,000K = reduce position size and reassess. FOMC June 17 and ADR SEC clearance ~June 22 are the scheduled catalysts that could force either outcome.

## The Fab Digital Twin case — why it matters beyond today's chart

The NVIDIA Omniverse integration deserves more attention than it gets from the daily price action. When SK Hynix builds 'Fab Digital Twins' — virtual replicas of its fabrication plants running on NVIDIA's physics simulation platform — it is not just adopting a productivity tool. It is creating a dependency: SK Hynix's manufacturing intelligence will be co-developed with and partly owned by NVIDIA infrastructure. Every future-generation HBM process improvement will run on cuLitho and PhysicsNeMo. The two companies are becoming operationally intertwined at the process level, not just the product level.

This matters for valuation because it raises the switching cost for both parties. NVIDIA cannot easily shift to a different memory supplier without losing the co-developed process knowledge embedded in the digital twin. SK Hynix cannot easily switch to a different AI compute platform without losing the manufacturing optimization data. The partnership is self-reinforcing, and the ₩44.2B equipment investment this week is the financial proof that SK Hynix is committing to the timeline, not just signing partnership agreements.
